This website is a virtual portfolio of all data stories completed by Walker Briggs throughout the spring of 2026. There are 5 data stories in total that rely on a variety of data sets and sustainable development goals to produce visual plots and diagrams. Throughout the semester I developed my interests in the shift to renewable energies, quality education, gender equality, wildlife, etc. My career goals are still fluid yet focused on the environment and sustainability. I have significant experience and research knowledge regarding geothermal energy production and the economic vitality of this resource. I am an Environment and Sustainability major with a minor in Economics.
